why: Python executes every line of a .pth file in site-packages that begins with import, each time any Python starts. That is how the pybitjs package re-runs itself (the 2026-10-05 review), and it is quieter than anything on the Node side. One carrying an indicator in this user's own site-packages is confirmed and can be quarantined: Python skips a .pth that is not there.

findings.match: Python startup file contains an indicator
